title: Interaction: Storm Tribunal × environment
answer: Storm Tribunal × environment: A finite loaded sky column resolves against its outermost motion-blocking surface: roofs above the requested height catch the strike, water expands radius at 72% damage, Pure Light amplifies it, Darkness consumes it, and safe zones, tagged amethyst, or powered wards refuse it. Every warning beat revalidates the live column before rank effects. No terrain, fire, or harmful vanilla lightning is created. Signature: Roof-grey grounding fracture, blue conductive circuitry, white-gold resonance, black-violet eclipse seal, privacy blue, amethyst violet, or ritual green-cyan ward.
